summary: Describes RSVP-TE signaling extensions for protecting and restoring just a segment of a GMPLS label switched path. It complements the end-to-end recovery extensions of RFC 4872 and discusses how they interact. It is a standards-track document.

eli5.summary: Instead of finding a new road for the whole trip, you only fix the broken part. This note explains how the network repairs just one stretch of a path.

questions: how to protect part of an lsp
